# möbius for macOS 0.10.22

- Bundles gateway 0.16.41, with protocol 95 and persisted-state formats unchanged.
- Background shell commands support explicit waits, immediate background execution, and completion notices in their owning chat.
- Intermediate provider text stays grouped with ongoing work before tool calls.
- OpenRouter requests use a bounded output allowance and project attribution.
- Sandbox failures explain why an operation was refused while preserving filesystem protection.
